stock.description: Tsui Wah Holdings Limited, an investment entity, primarily manages a network of dining establishments. As of March 31, 2022, its operations encompassed 85 restaurants strategically located across Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Singapore. The company also extends its services to food catering and management, alongside running a dedicated food and bakery manufacturing facility. Furthermore, it possesses valuable trademarks and owns various properties. This enterprise was founded in 1967, and its principal office is situated in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong. Tsui Wah Holdings Limited functions as a subsidiary under the umbrella of Cui Fa Limited.
